newsitem.title: UK: Hodder Headline says 1996 sales up 9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hodder Headline says 1996 sales up 9 pct.

text.p: British publisher Hodder Headline Plc said on Tuesday sales on a like-for-like basis grew by nine percent in 1996 after adjustment for exchange rate differences and the effect of discontinued agency and door-to-door sales.
In the final quarter of the year, sales were up 12 percent from the year-earlier quarter.
Group sales for 1996 totalled around 93 million pounds, up five percent before adjustment, Hodder Headline said.
